newsitem.title: UK: MAM backs MBO of Lloyds division.
newsitem.headline: MAM backs MBO of Lloyds division.

text.p: Mercury Asset Management said Wednesday it is backing a 52 million stg management buyout of the veterinary division of Lloyds Chemists.
Mercury's private equity division will invest 16.85 million stg in the veterinary division of Lloyds Chemists.
German drugs wholesaler Gehe purchased Lloyds Chemists in January after a long takeover battle.

The veterinary division, which specialises in the wholesale distribution of drugs, disposables and instruments to veterinary practices, is forecast to make a profit of 4.5 million stg on turnover of 120 million stg in 1997, Mercury said.

"This business has consistently out-performed its competitors and increased its market share from 29 percent to 38 percent in the last three years," said Nick Turner, a director at Mercury's private equity division.
"The investment is a demonstration of Mercury's focus on investing in market leaders with opportunities for further growth," he said.
The business comprises three divisions; National Veterinary Supplies, Arnolds Veterinary Products and Dales Pharmaceuticals.
The deal was initiated by KPMG Corporate Finance in Birmingham, which are acting as advisors to the deal.
